concepts.name: Chinese remainder theorem
concepts.gloss: The theorem that a system of congruences with pairwise coprime moduli has a unique solution modulo the product of the moduli.

evidence.quote: Cooley used the Chinese remainder theorem to convert one cyclic convolution into multidimensional

concepts.name: Convolution theorem
concepts.gloss: The fact that the transform of a convolution of two sequences is the pointwise product of their transforms.

concepts.name: Gaussian function
concepts.gloss: The bell-shaped function x ↦ e^(−x²), or a scaled and shifted copy of it, used as a smooth weight that decays rapidly away from its centre.

concepts.name: Matrix product
concepts.gloss: The matrix whose (i, j) entry is the sum over k of the entry in row i, column k of the first matrix times the entry in row k, column j of the second; it represents the composition of the two linear maps.

concepts.name: Transform
concepts.gloss: A linear map from one array of values to another array of the same kind, each output being a fixed weighted sum of the inputs, such as a discrete Fourier transform.
